units.source_text: 他姑妈经常和他在楼上吵架。

en.t: His aunt often quarreled with him upstairs.

units.source_text: 有时候他的养父母也会出面帮他们调节。

en.t: Sometimes his foster parents would also step in to mediate between them.

units.source_text: 但是他最爱的就是自己的这位姑妈。

en.t: But the person he loved most was this aunt of his.

units.source_text: 姑妈一辈子没有嫁人，他二十岁的时候，他姑妈已经快六十岁了。

en.t: His aunt had never married, and by the time he was twenty, she was already nearly sixty.
